# Toast

A succinct message that is displayed temporarily.

- **Import:** `import { Toast, ToastAction, ToastClose, ToastDescription, ToastProvider, ToastTitle, ToastViewport } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Feedback
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/feedback-toast--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Button,
  ThemeProvider,
  Toast,
  ToastAction,
  ToastDescription,
  ToastProvider,
  ToastTitle,
  ToastViewport,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function ToastExample() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <ToastProvider>
        <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Show Toast</Button>
        <Toast open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
          <div className="grid gap-1">
            <ToastTitle>Scheduled: Catch up</ToastTitle>
            <ToastDescription>
              Friday, February 10, 2023 at 5:57 PM
            </ToastDescription>
          </div>
          <ToastAction altText="Goto schedule">Undo</ToastAction>
        </Toast>
        <ToastViewport />
      </ToastProvider>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Toast

It forwards its ref to `HTMLLIElement`. Its props are `Omit<ToastPrimitive.ToastProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLLIElement>, "ref">`.

- `onPause`: `() => void`, optional.
- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `forceMount`: `true`, optional.

  Used to force mounting when more control is needed. Useful when
  controlling animation with React animation libraries.

- `defaultOpen`: `boolean`, optional.
- `open`: `boolean`, optional.
- `onOpenChange`: `(open: boolean) => void`, optional.
- `type`: `'foreground' | 'background'`, optional.
- `onEscapeKeyDown`: `DismissableLayerProps['onEscapeKeyDown']`, optional.
- `duration`: `number`, optional.

  Time in milliseconds that toast should remain visible for. Overrides value
  given to `ToastProvider`.

- `onResume`: `() => void`, optional.
- `onSwipeStart`: `(event: SwipeEvent) => void`, optional.
- `onSwipeMove`: `(event: SwipeEvent) => void`, optional.
- `onSwipeCancel`: `(event: SwipeEvent) => void`, optional.
- `onSwipeEnd`: `(event: SwipeEvent) => void`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## ToastProvider

Its props are `ToastPrimitive.ToastProviderProps`.

- `children`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `label`: `string`, optional, default `'Notification'`.

  An author-localized label for each toast. Used to help screen reader users
  associate the interruption with a toast.

- `duration`: `number`, optional, default `5000`.

  Time in milliseconds that each toast should remain visible for.

- `swipeDirection`: `SwipeDirection`, optional, default `'right'`.

  Direction of pointer swipe that should close the toast.

- `swipeThreshold`: `number`, optional, default `50`.

  Distance in pixels that the swipe must pass before a close is triggered.

## ToastViewport

It forwards its ref to `HTMLOListElement`. Its props are `Omit<ToastPrimitive.ToastViewportProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLOListElement>, "ref">`.

- `label`: `string`, optional, default `'Notifications ({hotkey})'`.

  An author-localized label for the toast viewport to provide context for screen reader users
  when navigating page landmarks. The available `{hotkey}` placeholder will be replaced for you.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `hotkey`: `string[]`, optional, default `['F8']`.

  The keys to use as the keyboard shortcut that will move focus to the toast viewport.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## ToastAction

It forwards its ref to `HTMLButtonElement`. Its props are `Omit<ToastPrimitive.ToastActionProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, "ref">`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `altText`: `string`, **required**.

  A short description for an alternate way to carry out the action. For screen reader users
  who will not be able to navigate to the button easily/quickly.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
